name: promotions
title: Promotions
summary: Discounts and sales campaigns: markdowns, percentage and fixed coupons, minimum-spend and free-shipping offers, flash sales, seller discounts and platform campaigns with seller consent. Owns eligibility, stacking, budgets and caps, the funding owner of every discount, coupon clipping and redemption, the Deals page data and campaign results.
owns: Campaigns: name, period with time zone, participating categories, products, offers or sellers, exclusions, eligible customers, discount type and value
Launch discount types: item markdown, percentage coupon, fixed-amount coupon, minimum-spend discount, free shipping
Growth discount types: flash sales with deal stock, purchase limits and real countdowns; bundles, quantity deals (phase 3)
Budget and usage caps, per-customer and per-order limits, maximum discount per order
Funding owner (platform, seller, shared) and the per-line funding split; platform-funded parts never reduce seller proceeds
Stacking rules and exclusions (with seller markdowns, other coupons, free shipping, flash prices)
Seller discounts (seller-funded) and seller participation in platform campaigns: invitation, offer eligibility, expected earnings impact, explicit consent, withdrawal
Finance funding confirmation before a platform or shared campaign can go live
Coupon codes (shared and unique), coupon clipping, redemption reservations and reversals
Eligibility evaluation for cart and checkout (in-process public API) with explained rejections and the items each discount covers
Deals page data: flash sales, coupons, clearance, upcoming events and event reminders
The 'was' price rule shown with campaign prices (lowest price in the previous 30 days), read from offers.lowestPrice so discount claims are authentic
Campaign results: sales, orders, discount cost by funder, margin impact, redemptions, seller participation and returns
notOwns: Offer base prices: offers (a markdown is a promotion layered on top of the offer price)
Offer price history: offers (offer_price_history); the reference 'was' price comes from offers.lowestPrice, promotions keeps no price history of its own
Applying a code to a cart or quote: cart and checkout endpoints, which call evaluateCart / reserveRedemption
Commission and seller ledger postings: finance (reads fundingSplitFor and the redemption events)
Campaign pages, banners and homepage sections: content; ad delivery for a campaign: advertising
Promotional messages: notifications; marketing consent: customers
Store credit, gift cards and loyalty: wallet

publicApi.name: priceOffers
publicApi.signature: (offerIds: uuid[], ctx: { customerId?: uuid, at?: datetime }) => OfferPromotion[]
publicApi.desc: Current markdown or flash price, was price, badges, purchase limit and countdown per offer. Used for product cards, the purchase box and cart lines so prices match everywhere (plan ch. 15: consistent across product page, cart, checkout and confirmation).

publicApi.name: evaluateCart
publicApi.desc: Runs eligibility, stacking, limits and budgets for a cart or checkout quote. Returns per-line discounts with the funding split, free-shipping packages, applied codes with the items they cover and rejected codes with a reason the customer can read. Pure read: nothing is reserved.

publicApi.name: reserveRedemption
publicApi.desc: Holds budget, usage counts and flash deal stock for a quote while payment runs. Fails with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED or DEAL_SOLD_OUT so checkout can show the revised total before the customer commits (plan ch. 6).

publicApi.name: commitRedemption
publicApi.signature: (reservationId: uuid, orderId: uuid, orderItemIds: map<string>) => Redemption[]
publicApi.desc: Binds a reservation to the placed order (line id → order item id). Also triggered by orders.order.placed.

publicApi.name: releaseRedemption
publicApi.desc: Releases held budget, usage and deal stock when payment fails or the quote expires.

publicApi.name: fundingSplitFor
publicApi.desc: Discount allocations of one order item with platform and seller parts. Finance charges commission on the price after the seller-funded part only and credits the platform-funded part to seller proceeds.

publicApi.name: refundShare
publicApi.desc: Coupon share to deduct when refunding part of an order (coupons are split across items by value). Used to cap refunds at the remaining refundable amount.

publicApi.name: getPublicCampaign
publicApi.desc: Name, period, terms and status for campaign pages, banners and ads.

publicApi.name: isCampaignActive
publicApi.desc: False when ended, paused, out of budget or sold out. Advertising stops linked ads; content hides teasers.

publicApi.name: liveDeals
publicApi.desc: Flash deals for the homepage Deals section.

publicApi.name: referencePrice
publicApi.desc: Honest 'was' price: delegates to offers.lowestPrice(offerId, referencePriceDays, campaignStart or now) and returns null when offers has no history for the window. No price history is kept in promotions.

publicApi.name: getDealsPage
publicApi.desc: Deals page data in one call: tab counts, live flash sales, clippable coupons (clipped state for the customer), the first clearance batch, upcoming events with reminder state, the combination rules and serverTime for countdowns. Same data as GET /api/store/promotions/deals.

publicApi.name: getFlashSale
publicApi.desc: One flash sale with live claimed meters, deal stock and countdown (GET /flash-sales/{campaignId}).

publicApi.name: couponsForProduct
publicApi.desc: Clippable coupons that cover each product, with the customer's clipped state (the coupons part of GET /products/{productId}). Batched per request.

publicApi.name: couponsForCustomer
publicApi.desc: My coupons: available and clipped, used and expired, with the rules line (GET /coupons).

publicApi.name: activeSellerPromotions
publicApi.signature: (sellerIds: uuid[], ctx: { customerId?: uuid, at?: datetime }) => map<PromoBanner[]>
publicApi.desc: Live seller-funded promotions for the storefront (automatic or by code), soonest ending first. Same eligibility and period rules as priceOffers; platform campaigns are not included.

publicApi.signature: (dataset: string, filters: json, principal: identity.Principal, cursor?: string) => { rows: json[], nextCursor?: string }
publicApi.desc: Export rows for reports dataset promotions.admin.campaigns (campaign results)

stateMachines.name: Promotion campaign
stateMachines.notes: Platform and shared campaigns must pass Finance (confirmFunding) before schedule. draft → schedule is allowed only for seller-funded discounts owned by a seller. Edits are locked in in_review. Material edits to an approved or scheduled campaign (discount, scope, budget, funding, period) reopen it to draft and need a new Finance confirmation; cosmetic edits (name, description, terms) do not. start/end run from jobs at startsAt/endsAt; end also fires on budget exhausted, usage cap reached or sold out (endedReason). resume returns to scheduled when the start time has not arrived. Live campaigns cannot be cancelled, only ended (redemptions already exist).

stateMachines.name: Seller participation
stateMachines.notes: accept records the exact consent text, the offers and the seller share; a seller's offers are included only after consent (plan ch. 15). withdraw is allowed before the campaign starts; after start it becomes requestWithdrawal and Marketing decides. remove is a staff or system action with a reason (offer became ineligible, seller restricted or suspended).

stateMachines.name: Redemption
stateMachines.notes: Reservations expire after reservationTtlMinutes unless committed. Reversal happens on item cancellation and refunds; usage counts are restored only for full cancellations before dispatch (setting restoreUsageOnCancel). Budget is not credited back for refunds after delivery unless refundRestoresBudget is on.

stateMachines.name: Flash item
stateMachines.notes: sellOut fires when claimed + reserved reaches dealStock. The regular offer stays purchasable at its regular price and is shown separately. restock is a staff edit that raises deal stock (audited).

COUPON_NOT_FOUND.meaning: No active campaign has this code.

COUPON_NOT_ELIGIBLE.meaning: The customer or cart does not meet the coupon's conditions. details.reason uses RejectedCode.reason.

BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.meaning: The campaign budget is used up; the revised total must be shown before ordering.

USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED.meaning: Total, per-customer or per-order limit reached.

DEAL_SOLD_OUT.meaning: Flash deal stock is used up; the regular offer is still available separately.

PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.meaning: Quantity above the per-customer unit limit. details.limit.

CAMPAIGN_LOCKED.meaning: Edits are locked while Finance reviews the funding.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.meaning: The seller must explicitly consent before its offers are included.

INVITATION_CLOSED.meaning: The response deadline has passed or the campaign was cancelled.

OFFER_NOT_ELIGIBLE.meaning: An offer does not meet the campaign rules. details.offers lists each reason.

INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.meaning: Deal stock is above the offer's available stock.

CODE_TAKEN.meaning: The coupon code is already used by another active or scheduled campaign.

notes: Funding rule (plan ch. 14–15): every discount allocation is split into platformPart and sellerPart. Finance charges commission on the item price after the seller-funded part only, and the platform-funded part is credited to seller proceeds, so a platform-funded coupon never reduces seller proceeds. Official Store items: the whole discount is a company cost and appears in company trading margin.
Coupons are split across the items they cover by item value; refundShare returns the share to deduct so refunds never exceed the remaining refundable amount (admin/order, account/cancel).

Evaluation order: markdowns and flash prices set the unit price; then coupons per seller package (couponsPerSellerPackage) honouring stacking flags and exclusive groups; then free shipping per package. Rejections always carry a customer-readable message and the items involved (store/checkout 'Coupon rejected').
Evaluation is deterministic for an evaluationId; checkout re-evaluates before placing and shows changes (store/checkout-review-changes). Reservations are idempotent per Idempotency-Key from checkout.
Flash sale stock is a promotional allocation on top of inventory: when deal stock ends the offer stays purchasable at its regular price and the Deals page shows it separately (plan ch. 15).

Was prices are the offer's lowest price in the look-back window (referencePriceDays) before the campaign starts. referencePrice and priceOffers read it from offers.lowestPrice (offers owns offer_price_history, the single source); promotions stores no daily prices. Campaign terms state the rule.
Seller views are scoped to the caller's seller account; sellers never see other sellers' consent or earnings.

Bundles and quantity deals (DiscountRule.bundle / quantityTiers) are phase 3: the kinds are accepted only when the phase-3 feature flag is on, otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED. Flash sales are phase 2 (plan 'growth promotions'); their endpoints are marked phase 2.
access is an optional dependency here: funding confirmation checks the approval action promotions.budgets.approve through access.check / access.requestApproval when access is enabled.

Campaign pages, banners and the Deals homepage section are content; promotional ads are advertising. Both read campaign status through getPublicCampaign / isCampaignActive and react to promotions.campaign.ended.
